tools.name: agentgas_wallet
tools.description: Free. Delivered orders, current flat fee ($0.10 / $0.05 after 3 / $0.02 after 10), orders to the next tier, and prepaid credit balance for a wallet.

tools.name: agentgas_credit_message
tools.description: Free. Returns the exact EIP-191 message to sign with the payer wallet to spend prepaid credit on a top-up (no x402 payment). Then POST /v1/gas {credit:{message,signature}}. Credit: start with a 0.09 USDC pack (fits the $0.10 x402 cap, 0.099 credit) or 5/10/20 USDC packs, all with +10% bonus, at /v1/

tools.name: agentgas_quote
tools.description: Free price quote: how much USDC (on Base, paid via gasless x402) buys a given amount of native gas (ETH on base/arbitrum/optimism, POL on polygon). Returns price_usdc, breakdown and the exact x402 URL to pay. Rejects bad input or over-capacity before any payment.

tools.name: agentgas_status
tools.description: Live per-chain float, availability, prices and daily caps of the AgentGas service. Check before paying.

tools.name: agentgas_order
tools.description: Status of an AgentGas order by order_id: pending, processing, delivered (with payout_tx on the destination chain) or refunded (with refund_tx on Base).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?src=mcp-registry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: agentgas_how_to_buy · Private data: agentgas_ensure_gas, agentgas_wallet, agentgas_credit_message · Public sink: agentgas_credit_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: agentgas_how_to_buy · Private data: agentgas_ensure_gas, agentgas_wallet, agentgas_credit_message · Public sink: agentgas_credit_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
